name: Peneda-Gerês
description: The only national park in the country, up against the Spanish border. Granite, wild ponies, and villages with communal grain stores still standing on stilts. The Arado waterfall is the one everyone finds; walk twenty minutes upstream and you get it to yourself.
getting: Two hours from Porto by car. Buses reach Arcos de Valdevez and then stop being useful — you need your own wheels for the park roads.
